title: Proofing Attempt Limits and Session Format by Pathway — Claimant Identity Verification
content:
Each Claimant Identity Verification pathway allows a fixed number of proofing attempts and has its own session format. Hour figures on this card are elapsed hours.

## Attempts and lockout

| Pathway | Attempts allowed before the case is failed | Lockout after a failed attempt (hours) |
|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | 3 | 24 |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | 2 | 24 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | 2 | 0 (no lockout) |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | 2 | 0 (no lockout) |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | 2 | 0 (no lockout) |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | 2 | 0 (no lockout) |

## Session format

| Pathway | Live selfie matched to the photo document | Live video session with a trusted referee | Emailed proofing link or in-person barcode valid for (hours) | Contact-center agent may record an attempt over the phone |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | required | not required | 72 | no |
| Video Trusted Referee Session | not required | required | 72 | no |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | not required | not required | 0 (none issued) | no |
| In-Person Proofing — USPS Retail Location | not required | not required | 168 | no |
| Documentary Verification by Mail | not required | not required | 0 (none issued) | no |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | not required | not required | 0 (none issued) | no |

## Points of judgement

- **Lockout of 0 hours.** A lockout figure of 0 means the pathway has no lockout between attempts.
- **Link or barcode validity of 0 hours.** A figure of 0 means no emailed proofing link or in-person barcode is issued on that pathway.
- **Phone-assisted attempts.** No pathway allows a contact-center agent to record a proofing attempt for the claimant over the phone.
- **Validity in days.** The 168-hour validity of a USPS barcode is seven full days of elapsed time; the 72-hour validity of an online or video link is three.
- **Counting to the limit.** Counting failed attempts only, on Online Identity Proofing (IAL2), a third failed attempt reaches the limit of 3; on any other pathway, the second failed attempt reaches the limit of 2.
